tests.e2e/display-polish-2.mjs: pass (also re-run at 1280x720 and on Low graphics with a fresh Vite dep cache: pass, no 'Multiple instances of Three.js' warning, no re-optimise)
tests.e2e/dps-readout.mjs: FAILED on the first full run (844x390 chika: sameRow false, label was 'DPS (full wing)'); passed on a second 844x390 run (label 'DPS'). Timing-dependent.

findings.where: src/ui/styles/home.css (icon-only Events tab, max-height 480 and max-width 759), screen 667x375
findings.what: The days-left sticker still sits on the lantern: sticker x 599.5-625.6 / bottom 227, lantern x 612-632 / top 222, so they overlap by 5 px vertically and 13 px horizontally. The v0.1.62 patch note says the sticker 'no longer overlaps its lantern', which is not true on small phones.
findings.fix: Give the icon-only tab --evt-drop: 7px as well (the lantern then runs 229-249 in a 209-255 tab: 2 px under the sticker and 6 px above the bottom), or move the sticker clear of it. Otherwise, scope the patch note.

findings.where: src/ui/battle/chikaPanel.js (.bt-stat-short only when the label is 'DPS') and e2e/dps-readout.mjs, 844x390
findings.what: wingNumbers().building is true whenever any drone is down or relaunching, not only at launch. Mid-wave, the DPS cell switches between 1 and 2 columns, so the Overall grid gains or loses a row and Per target and everything below jump while the player watches. The new e2e assertion (sameRow) depends on that timing: it failed in 1 of my 2 runs.
findings.fix: Keep the main DPS cell at one column in both states, e.g. a label that fits one column ('DPS (wing)', or 'DPS' with the full-wing note in the tooltip or aria text). Make the e2e assert per label, or wait until the wing is full before it reads the row.

findings.what: The list is incomplete against grep: 'three/addons/geometries/DecalGeometry.js' (src/models/face.js) and 'three/addons/modifiers/SimplifyModifier.js' (dynamic import in src/models/body.js) are missing. With a fresh cache, the battle at High and Low showed no warning and no re-optimise, so this is not a live problem.
findings.fix: Add both to the include list.

findings.what: While paused, dt is 0 but frameDt is above 0 and the sim time stands still, so the speed estimate decays toward 0. Before, the dt > 0 guard held it. On resume at 2x or 3x, the doll runs at 1x (Math.max(1, speed)) for about 10-15 frames.
The panel now stands beside Iroha and reads as intentional. At close zoom, its rim touches her sleeve, and at 1280x720 (origin 0.63 in front) it touches her hand: about 0 px margin.
When Tenka is selected, the prop swaps to hlMaterial, which has no accent emissive, so the coilgun loses its violet look while she is selected.
findings.fix: Apply look.glow to hlMaterial too, or accept it as part of the selected look.

findings.what: The EVENTS word sits 7 px lower than the CO-OP word beside it on the same row (label tops 247.5 and 240.5). The sticker clears the lantern by exactly 2 px at all three sizes, as specified.
findings.fix: Optional: drop 5 px with a 1 px smaller sticker, or accept it as is.

findings.fix: For example: 'Ruri's Tree tab shows abilities coming in a later update with a grey ⚡ sticker; only live ones are yellow.' Also see the Events MEDIUM above.
